onboarding.page1_description: Qeran provides you with a safe and serious environment to find your other half within Islamic guidelines.
onboarding.page2_description: Our smart system helps you find who suits you based on your answers and interests.
onboarding.page3_description: Connect with others through safe and monitored messages to ensure a positive experience.
onboarding.splash_tagline: A serious path to marriage — privacy, compatibility and Islamic values.

essence.title: Get to know the personality, fully private
essence.body: Get to know their values, interests, lifestyle and marriage goals. Photos stay hidden for both sides and are revealed only after mutual interest and mutual consent.
essence.highlight: Your privacy is our priority — your photos and data stay protected.
essence.lock_note: The photo appears only after mutual interest and consent

mediation.title: Serious, matchmaker-supervised communication
mediation.body: As soon as you join, a professional matchmaker from the Qeran team is assigned to you, guiding your entire journey in full confidentiality and with a deep understanding of your values and needs.
mediation.highlight: The matchmaker manages all contact up to the exchange of families’ details, preserving seriousness and privacy.
